subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers repair this contributor branch or select https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback implementation?
rationale: The remaining blocker is not only code repair: the branch is conflicting, proof is not inspectable, and a member-authored overlapping PR targets the same canonical issue, so automation cannot safely choose the landing candidate.

options.title: Repair This Branch Before Merge
options.body: Refresh the branch, narrow the detector, preserve action metadata, and require inspectable app-auth proof before another merge-readiness review.

options.title: Choose The Member Candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 as the canonical path if maintainers prefer that implementation after it is refreshed and verified.

options.title: Waive Live Proof Deliberately
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept source/API-contract proof for the live Google Chat branch, but the predicate and metadata blockers still need repair first.

recommendation.title: Repair This Branch Before Merge
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch, narrow the detector, preserve action metadata, and require inspectable app-auth proof before another merge-readiness review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Google Chat reply-delivery and media/action history makes steipete the best available routing owner for choosing the landing path.
